digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / Pydantic AI model construction
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs model targets using the legacy `openai:` prefix because v2 will reinterpret it as Responses instead of Chat Completions.
Rebar's model construction in `_pai_model` and `_resolve_target` composes or passes through the ambiguous `openai:` qualifier, causing runtime warnings that fail tests when promoted to errors.

ProviderSession's custom-endpoint builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override guard match only the legacy `openai` provider name, so normalizing targets to `openai-chat:` would regress endpoint routing without updating both gates.

Normalizing inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to the explicit `openai-chat:` prefix preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics and restores operator-approved compatibility without changing other providers.
The repair must treat `openai` and `openai-chat` as compatible provider names for conflict detection and endpoint lookup while emitting only the explicit qualifier in constructed model strings.
